To determine the total number of checks Buford writes per year, we must strictly adhere to the information provided in the problem statement. We will calculate the annual frequency for each specific expense mentioned and sum them up.

**Step 1: Electric Bill Checks**
The problem states Buford writes a check for the electric bill once per month.
$$1 \text{ check/month} \times 12 \text{ months/year} = 12 \text{ checks/year}$$

**Step 2: Gas Bill Checks**
The problem states he writes a check for the gas bill every month.
$$1 \text{ check/month} \times 12 \text{ months/year} = 12 \text{ checks/year}$$

**Step 3: Church Checks**
The problem states he writes a check to the church twice per month.
$$2 \text{ checks/month} \times 12 \text{ months/year} = 24 \text{ checks/year}$$

**Step 4: Pest and Lawn Service Checks**
The problem states he writes a check to the pest and lawn service quarterly. A year has 4 quarters.
$$1 \text{ check/quarter} \times 4 \text{ quarters/year} = 4 \text{ checks/year}$$

**Step 5: Total Calculation**
Sum the checks from all categories:
$$\text{Total} = 12 \text{ (Electric)} + 12 \text{ (Gas)} + 24 \text{ (Church)} + 4 \text{ (Pest/Lawn)}$$
$$\text{Total} = 24 + 24 + 4$$
$$\text{Total} = 48 + 4$$
$$\text{Total} = 52$$

Based on the text provided, Buford writes 52 checks per year.

Final answer: 52
